parsed.rationale: All four duplicate `SequentialMockSession.data` methods reside in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift`, a test file in the `Artwork` package. Although the pipeline did not set `is_test: true` on these records, the file path (`Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift`) and the enclosing type names (`iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`, `LastFMArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`) unambiguously identify these as per-test-class mock helpers. Each `SequentialMockSession` is a nested mock type scoped to its own test class, so the duplication is intentional test-fixture isolation rather than accidental redundancy. Consolidating them would couple otherwise independent test suites and reduce clarity.
